title: Loop+ Membership Eligibility Proof Standards by Plan
content:
Two families of Loop+ Membership plans are open only to buyers who prove an eligibility: Loop+ Access Monthly requires proof of government assistance, and the two student plans require proof of student enrollment. Every Loop+ plan is open only to buyers aged at least 18. The plans that require no proof carry no verification period, re-verification interval, grace period or rollover plan.

## Entry requirements and accepted proof

| Plan | Minimum age | Eligibility the plan requires | Documents accepted as eligibility proof |
|---|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | 18 | government assistance | SNAP EBT card, Medicaid card, SSI award letter |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | 18 | student enrollment | edu email, enrollment letter |
| Loop+ Student Annual | 18 | student enrollment | edu email, enrollment letter |
| Loop+ Monthly | 18 | none | none |
| Loop+ Annual | 18 | none | none |
| Loop+ Household Annual | 18 | none | none |

## Verification periods and rollover

| Plan | Calendar days after sign-up to provide proof | Months between re-verifications | Calendar days of grace after a re-verification falls due | Plan the membership moves to when re-verification is not completed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | 14 | 12 | 30 | Loop+ Monthly |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | 14 | 12 | 30 | Loop+ Monthly |
| Loop+ Student Annual | 14 | 12 | 30 | Loop+ Annual |
| Loop+ Monthly | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Loop+ Annual | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Loop+ Household Annual | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |

## Definitions

- **Eligibility proof type**: the eligibility the plan requires.
- **Accepted documents**: the documents accepted as eligibility proof for that plan; a document listed for one eligibility type is not listed for the other.
- **Verification period**: the calendar days after sign-up to provide eligibility proof; not applicable when no proof is required.
- **Re-verification interval**: the months between eligibility re-verifications; not applicable when no proof is required.
- **Re-verification grace**: the calendar days after a re-verification falls due before the membership moves to the rollover plan; not applicable when no proof is required.
- **Failed re-verification rollover plan**: the plan the membership moves to when re-verification is not completed, named by its official plan name; not applicable when no proof is required.

## Notes on the tables

- The two student plans accept the same documents but roll over to different plans: Loop+ Student Monthly rolls over to Loop+ Monthly, and Loop+ Student Annual rolls over to Loop+ Annual.
- A SNAP EBT card, a Medicaid card or an SSI award letter is accepted proof for Loop+ Access Monthly only; an edu email or an enrollment letter is accepted proof for the student plans only.
